scale_method: Scale determined using architectural CAD drawing titles ('SCALE 1.0:30.0' / '1.0:40.0' in INSITE Visual-FM) cross-calibrated against standard single interior door widths normalized to 0.90 m and standard double doors to 1.80 m. Coordinate system origin (0,0) is fixed at the primary top-left building footprint corner on Floor 1, extending horizontally east (+X) and vertically south (+Y).

floors.notes: 100 Level plan shows basement/lower ground profile. South side features an unexcavated semicircular retaining wall boundary and grade exit.
200 Level represents the stage/base tier of lecture halls DCC 308, 318, 324, 330, and 337 (marked 'Open to Above' / 'Unexcavated'). Direct grade-level egress exists to the south and northeast.

300 Level is the primary campus entry floor featuring the main glazed south concourse, five fan-shaped lecture halls (308, 318, 324, 330, 337), upper projection booths, and northwest/southwest exterior connections.

global_notes: The building is stepped along a hillside grade. The NE elevator/stair core serves as the primary vertical anchoring datum across all three levels. Floors 2 and 3 overlap substantially, with the main lecture halls occupying two-story stepped volumes entered from the top tier on Level 3 (campus concourse level) and the bottom stage tier on Level 2. Level 1 is situated under the north and west footprint wings with southern grade egress.
